svg.title: Figure 5 | The risk of reusing status after edits
svg.desc: Numbers show the chronology of a synthetic example. Data B must be checked again; data A’s result cannot be reused. This is not a report of an incident at a real bank.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 5 | The risk of reusing status after edits
The system shows that data A passed.
Step 2 | The user edits the data
The user changes data A into B, including important amount fields.
Step 3 | The system still shows a pass
The system reuses data A’s result without checking B.
Step 4 | The user exports a report
Unchecked data B is exported, creating risk.
Numbers show the chronology of a synthetic example. Data B must be
checked again; data A’s result cannot be reused. This is not a report
of an incident at a real bank.
